greet.speaker: Signpost
greet.text: A crude marker, clearly added long after whatever this place originally was: "THE SUNKEN VAULT OF KARNETH — TURN BACK." Someone has scratched out "TURN BACK" and written "OR DON'T" beneath it.
greet.text_zh: 一塊粗糙的標記，明顯是在這地方原本的用途之後很久才被加上的：「卡奈斯沉沒寶庫——回頭吧。」有人把「回頭吧」劃掉，在下面又寫了「或者別回頭」。
